SELECT t.tdm52_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , t.tdm52_title AS title , t.tdm52_check_item AS check_item , t.tdm52_checker_id AS checker_id , t.tdm52_checker_nm AS checker_name , t.tdm52_check_result_nm AS check_result_name , t.tdm52_check_status_cd AS check_status_code , t.tdm52_check_status_nm AS check_status_name FROM ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl.* , CASE WHEN tdm52_checker_id IS NULL THEN '(미지정)' ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(tdm52_checker_id) END AS tdm52_checker_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckResult', tdm52_check_result_cd, tdm52_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm52_check_result_nm , f_cdnm('TdmCheckStatus', tdm52_check_status_cd, tdm52_company_id, f_today()) AS tdm52_check_status_nm , '['|| tdm43_role_nm || '-' || CASE WHEN tdm10_common_yn = 'true' THEN '공통'
ELSE '개별' END ||'] ' ||tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS tdm52_title , CONCAT('('||tdm43_manl_cd||') ', tdm43_check_item) AS tdm52_check_item , tdm43_role_nm AS tdm52_role_nm , tdm43_task_nm AS tdm52_task_nm , tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm AS task_detail_nm , tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS task_duty_nm , tdm43_manl_cd AS manl_cd FROM tdm52_chck_manl INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_id = tdm52_manl_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm43_task_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ) t WHERE CONCAT(task_duty_nm, tdm52_check_item, tdm52_checker_nm) ILIKE #{searchText}
AND tdm52_checker_id IS NULL
ORDER BY tdm52_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm52_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , task_detail_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , task_duty_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , manl_cd
